WHERE n.active = true
WITH t, collect({id:e.id, kind:e.kind, status:e.status, distance_m:n.distance_m, sources:n.sources}) AS near

  CASE

    WHEN r.kind='building' AND r.status='collapsed' THEN s+30
    WHEN r.kind='building' AND r.status='damaged' THEN s+10
    WHEN r.kind='road' AND r.status='blocked' THEN s+20
    WHEN r.kind='facility' AND r.status='closed' THEN s+25
    ELSE s 
  END) AS risk
WHERE risk > 0
RETURN t.id AS id, t.name AS name, risk, [x IN near | {id:x.id, kind:x.kind, status:x.status}] AS context ORDER BY risk DESC LIMIT 1
